run30-steady-tf.fault_window_status: zero_matching_future_extrapolation_events; events=[] is observed zero, not missing data

receipt.scope: Independent read-only clock probe executed while root Gazebo supervisor 96593 remained running; no ROS node or system-time changes.

definitions.max_adjacent_bag_gap_s: Maximum adjacent receive-stamp difference in bag reader order, over the entire recorded series.
definitions.max_receipt_gap_between_header_advances_: Maximum receive-stamp gap between receipts establishing a strictly higher header high-water mark; repeated/backward stamps do not reset advancement.
definitions.max_adjacent_header_step_s: Maximum adjacent source header-stamp difference, distinct from receive interval.
definitions.zero_errors: An empty events array explicitly means no matching future-extrapolation log events; full-series statistics are still computed.

limitations: Recorder used --use-sim-time: receipt stamps are recorder ROS time, not independent wall arrival. System clock probe remains on its own monotonic time axis.
Full series means the observed bag interval; gaps before first/after last receipt are censored. The last partial header-advance wait is reported separately.
No ROS node/playback or Nav2 private TF-cache reconstruction. A bag gap alone cannot isolate publishing, transport, or recorder scheduling.
Each run has a different path and duration; full-run maxima are descriptive, not matched-load causal proof.
Zero matching future-extrapolation events does not prove zero other TF/navigation errors; extrapolation log-line count is also retained.
